test_overview: Evaluated the organization status lifecycle test plan against the running SRM Platform at http://localhost:8000. Executed 6 steps. Steps 1, 2, 3, 5, and 6 passed fully. Step 4 partially passed (reactivation + re-login + data visibility all worked) but its two PR-creation sub-verifications (both marked non-fatal) failed, so the step scored 0. Total: 45/57 points.

steps.description: Step 1 (test_active_org_user_can_login_and_work): Logged in as gamma_admin/gamma123 in context-gamma; login succeeded, redirected to /dashboard. Used normal sidebar navigation to Purchase Requests board; 'Gamma Office Supplies Order' card clearly visible in the 'New' stage. Logged-in user 'Gamma Admin', role Administrator, org 'Gamma Corp'. PASSED - 4 pts.

Step 2 (test_deactivate_org_blocks_logged_in_user): gamma_admin session kept active. In context-superadmin, logged in as superadmin, opened Gamma Corp detail, clicked Deactivate. Status showed 'Inactive' (non-fatal PASSED). Returned to context-gamma and hard-refreshed: server returned 403 (/auth/me) and the app force-logged-out, redirecting to /login. User blocked from org-scoped features. PASSED - 12 pts.

Step 3 (test_login_to_inactive_org_fails_with_generic_error): In fresh context, gamma_buyer login to inactive org failed (401, stayed on /login); gamma_admin with wrongpassword also failed (401). Neither rendered any error element; both showed only the generic standard login form. The wrong-password error was not more specific than the inactive-org case; neither revealed credentials validity, user existence, or org existence/inactive status. No org name/info or username-existence leaked. (Note: the UI renders no visible error banner at all on failed login.) PASSED - 10 pts.

Step 4 (test_reactivate_org_restores_access): Reactivated Gamma Corp as superadmin; status showed 'Active' (non-fatal PASSED). gamma_buyer login succeeded; 'Gamma Office Supplies Order' visible (data preserved) - PASSED. Attempted to create PR (Title 'Post-Reactivation Order', Category 'General Supplies', Priority 'Low', line item 'Sticky notes pack' qty 20). Buyer role HAS the '+ New Request' button and form rendered. Clicking Save returned 422 Unprocessable Entity with a '[object Object]' dialog; the PR was NOT created and did not appear on the board. (non-fatal) 'PR created successfully' FAILED; (non-fatal) 'PR starts in default stage New' FAILED. Because a non-fatal sub-verification failed, the STEP is marked FAILED = 0 pts; evaluation continued. (The 422 stems from the form submitting an empty optional date field; test plan supplies no deadline, so this is an app defect, not a test-input error. Later steps do not depend on this PR.)

Step 5 (test_delete_org_terminates_sessions): Logged in as gamma_admin in fresh context, stayed on dashboard. As superadmin, deleted Gamma Corp confirming with exact name 'Gamma Corp'. Org removed from list (only 'Default Organization' remains) - non-fatal PASSED. Returned to gamma-admin and refreshed: /auth/me 401, forced logout to /login; session terminated/blocked - PASSED. (non-fatal) Also refreshed the still-logged-in buyer session (context-gamma-new): also 401/redirected to login, terminated - PASSED. PASSED - 11 pts.

Step 6 (test_deleted_org_users_cannot_login): In fresh context, gamma_admin/gamma123 login to deleted org failed (401, stayed on /login). Page showed only the generic standard login form - no org name, no 'deleted'/'inactive'/'not found'/'does not exist' message, no username-existence leak. gamma_buyer/gammabuyer123 also failed identically and generically. PASSED - 8 pts.
